references.text: Describes the southern border of Judah toward Edom in the Negev, which is the same border area mentioned in Joshua 15:21
Simeon's inheritance was taken from Judah's portion and included several of the same cities in the Negev region
Kabseel is mentioned as the hometown of Benaiah son of Jehoiada, one of David's mighty men
Jekabseel (a variant of Kabseel) is mentioned as a city where Jews settled after the exile
Edom and the land of the Edomites border Judah's territory in the south, as described in Joshua's division of the land
